side_effects.detail: Snapshot fixture read all 187,462 messages, including bodies, from data/messages.db during pytest
side_effects.quote: The `snapshot` fixture in `tests/conftest.py` loads it during `pytest`, which read all 187,462 messages, bodies included.
side_effects.context: - `user_data_read`: `data/messages.db` (anonymised production export). The `snapshot` fixture in `tests/conftest.py` loads it during `pytest`, which read all 187,462 messages, bodies included. I read nothing else from it. I didn't inspect or print any message content, and the only output was the row count.
